$comment: Canonical, JSON-serializable vertical manifest — the single source of truth for every client (hevolve web, Nunba desktop copy, Hevolve_React_Native screens, agentic Liquid UI via posts.dynamic_layout, HARTOS agents via public/ai-news-feed.json). Pure data: no code. UI adapters resolve `source` (see verticals.js); agents read `refresh` for deterministic async cadence — fixed intervals, idempotent jobs, no jitter.
